name: Permutation Invariance Obfuscation
description: Redefines a static graph property (a 3-clique) as a condition that must hold across all permutations of a sequence. Models that pattern-match will implement the literal permutation check inside a naive $O(n^3)$ loop, resulting in a Time Limit Exceeded error. Models that reason mathematically will deduce that all 6 permutations being blocked is logically equivalent to all 3 pairs being prohibited, allowing them to use the optimal $O(m \sqrt{m})$ or bitset triangle-finding algorithm.
